- The original 256-bit loop is the `#else` fallback; shared `Q4Bits_AVX2`, Q6_K, dispatch, and headers are untouched. Diff is 79 insertions, 0 deletions; brace balance 20/20; no non-ASCII; guards match the existing `_mm512_slli_epi16` convention.
